note: Refined art set for NAS Bridge (draft, replaces the glossy 3D props). Direction: Arknights / Endfield official-site feel — big simple shapes, lots of negative space, few details. Generate with built-in image_gen, export to WebP (quality ~82), save under web/src/assets/ with the given file name. Equipment drawings are pure grayscale line art on white; the UI recolors them per theme with CSS (multiply on light, invert + screen on dark) and supplies the yellow itself, so the images must contain no color. No text, no logos, no people, no watermark.

style.equipment: Technical blueprint line drawing: thin uniform black ink strokes on a pure white background, flat orthographic or clean isometric view, no shading, no gradients, no textures, no color. At most about 40 major shapes; prefer large panels over small parts. A few dashed construction lines and one or two small dimension tick marks are allowed. Generous white margin around the object.
style.scene: Minimal cinematic environment: few large simple masses, strong silhouette, at least half of the frame calm negative space, desaturated graphite and ash gray, at most one small safety-yellow element, soft haze. Not busy, no clusters of small lights.

scenes.name: access-hero
scenes.usage: Full-bleed login hero. Left 45% carries the huge NAS BRIDGE title and the login form.
scenes.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: minimal cinematic hero background for the login page of a private storage network. Primary request: one colossal monolithic data relay tower standing on a flat ash-gray plain under a pale overcast sky, seen from far away at a low angle. The tower is a simple stack of large angular graphite and off-white slabs with one thin vertical safety-yellow stripe as the only color. A faint distant ring structure barely visible in the haze. Composition: ultra-wide 16:9, tower in the right third, left half almost empty sky and plain for typography, horizon low. Style: premium science-fiction game key art, large simple masses, very few details, strong silhouette, soft atmospheric haze, medium-low contrast so it works under both dark and light overlays. Constraints: no clusters of small lights, no cables, no machinery clutter, no UI, no text, no letters, no digits, no logos, no people, no watermark.
